failed_apis.why_tried: The UWP camera page was copied with its original live preview control.
failed_apis.root_cause: CaptureElement is not available in WinUI 3.
failed_apis.fix: Replace the preview surface with Image plus SoftwareBitmapSource and request preview frames from MediaCapture.

failed_apis.why_tried: The migration skill claimed the window-scoped Windows App SDK DisplayInformation retained UWP orientation members.
failed_apis.root_cause: Microsoft.Graphics.Display.DisplayInformation exposes color/stereo display data, not CurrentOrientation, NativeOrientation, or OrientationChanged.
failed_apis.fix: Do not map UWP orientation members to Microsoft.Graphics.Display.DisplayInformation; use XamlRoot for scale and a purpose-specific monitor/device orientation solution only when required.

failed_apis.why_tried: The UWP camera page subscribed to Application.Current lifecycle events.
failed_apis.root_cause: WinUI 3 desktop Application does not expose the UWP Suspending and Resuming events.
failed_apis.fix: Move cleanup/restart to explicit window/page lifetime events or use Windows App SDK lifecycle activation where applicable.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md Step 3 and final build instructions
doc_errors.correct: Use native dotnet build <project.csproj>; reserve winapp run/Test-AppLaunch.ps1 for package registration and launch.

doc_errors.wrong: The table says Microsoft.Graphics.Display.DisplayInformation.CreateForWindowId keeps NativeOrientation / CurrentOrientation / DPI members.
doc_errors.correct: The Windows App SDK type supports window-scoped color/stereo information but not UWP orientation or DPI properties; XamlRoot.RasterizationScale covers XAML scaling, while physical orientation needs a separate platform-specific design.

special_apis.special_handling: WinUI 3 has no CaptureElement; render requested VideoFrame data through SoftwareBitmapSource and keep a visible no-device fallback.
Shared code, XAML, and assets can live outside the project directory; migration inventory must follow Include plus Link metadata rather than relying only on recursive file enumeration.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The skill documented a command that is not part of the installed winapp CLI.
The unsupported UWP preview control remained in XAML after the agent recreated the page without resolving its injected migration TODO.
errors_encountered.fix: Applied the #capture pattern and replaced it with an Image-backed preview.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The camera edit used Win32Interop without importing or qualifying Microsoft.UI.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent ultimately removed the unused window-display initialization.

errors_encountered.error: CS1061 DisplayInformation has no OrientationChanged/CurrentOrientation and CS0103 DisplayOrientations
errors_encountered.root_cause: The skill incorrectly mapped UWP orientation APIs to Microsoft.Graphics.Display.DisplayInformation.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent removed orientation-dependent code and used a neutral rotation path.

errors_encountered.root_cause: UWP lifecycle event subscriptions were retained against Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application.
errors_encountered.fix: Removed the unsupported subscriptions and handlers.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Adding Windows.System for Launcher introduced a second DispatcherQueuePriority type.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909/WMC1111 could not resolve local:Scenario for x:DataType
errors_encountered.root_cause: The reconstructed shell's compiled-binding DataTemplate did not resolve during a build already containing multiple code and XAML failures.
errors_encountered.fix: Changed the template to runtime Binding without x:DataType.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The element swap renamed the XAML control but left two code-behind references.
errors_encountered.fix: Changed the remaining size references to PreviewImage.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The Windows.System using was removed to resolve an ambiguity while an unqualified Launcher call remained.
It accompanied unresolved XAML type/binding failures rather than identifying an independent runtime defect.
errors_encountered.fix: Resolved the concrete XAML and code errors; the internal compiler error disappeared.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The prescribed winapp build command printed CLI help and exited 1.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: One failed command before switching to dotnet build.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent used dotnet build for all subsequent compile passes.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Replace every migration-skill winapp build instruction with dotnet build.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Bootstrap mapped only five local files, while the agent manually browsed and recreated linked SharedContent App/MainPage/styles/assets.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Multiple source reads followed by four large manual patches before the first build.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The bootstrap did not follow external MSBuild Link items, despite claiming to be the complete inventory.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent manually copied selected shared files and assets.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Teach Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to resolve linked migration inputs and include them in mapping/TODO processing.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The first build failed on CaptureElement; the agent guessed a nonexistent pattern anchor before finding the correct one.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: One failed build, one failed anchor lookup, then a grep and successful anchor fetch.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The agent regenerated the XAML and did not follow the bootstrap TODO anchor.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Fetched #capture and applied the Image/SoftwareBitmapSource pattern.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Follow the existing TODO anchor and preserve TODOs until each adaptation is complete.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: One build emitted a large batch of orientation, lifecycle, namespace ambiguity, binding, and stale-name errors.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Three failed builds and two corrective patches before success.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The camera adaptation was applied as a broad rewrite using one incorrect API mapping and without checking all renamed references.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Removed unsupported orientation/lifecycle code, qualified ambiguous APIs, downgraded one binding, and fixed stale names.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Correct the DisplayInformation guidance, document desktop lifecycle events, and make element-swap reference cleanup explicit.
